# UrbanDrive

> Premium and luxury car rental platform offering executive and high-performance vehicles for on-demand rental across multiple cities.

UrbanDrive is a full-stack car rental management platform providing curated luxury and executive vehicle rentals with white-glove service, instant approval, and 24/7 concierge support.

## Pages

- [Home](https://car-rental-system-ivory-three.vercel.app/): Overview of UrbanDrive's luxury fleet and service offering
- [Fleet](https://car-rental-system-ivory-three.vercel.app/fleet): Browse available vehicles for rental
- [About](https://car-rental-system-ivory-three.vercel.app/about): UrbanDrive's brand philosophy and heritage
- [Contact](https://car-rental-system-ivory-three.vercel.app/contact): Get in touch with the UrbanDrive concierge team

## Notes

- Car availability and pricing are dynamic and fetched in real time; this file describes site structure, not live inventory.
- Admin, authentication, and account pages are excluded as they are not part of the public content surface.
